translations.idiomatic: The Supervising Sacrifice and Supervising Ritual stations are on the west, facing east;

sentences.zh: 皆北上。

translations.literal: All with north as superior.
translations.idiomatic: In each case the northern position is superior.

sentences.zh: 太廟令陳祝版於室右之祝案，又率祠祭局設籩豆簠簋。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple places the prayer boards on the prayer table to the right of the chamber; he also leads the Sacrificial Offerings Bureau in setting out baskets, trays, grain vessels, and wine vessels.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple places the prayer boards on the prayer table to the right of the chamber and leads the Sacrificial Offerings Bureau in setting out baskets, trays, grain vessels, and wine vessels.

sentences.zh: 每室左十有二籩，右十有二豆，俱為四行。

translations.literal: On the left of each chamber are twelve baskets; on the right twelve trays—all in four rows.
translations.idiomatic: To the left of each chamber are twelve baskets and to the right twelve trays, all arranged in four rows.

sentences.zh: 登三在籩豆之間，铏三次之，簠二、簋二又次之，簠左簋右，俎七在簠簋之南，香案一次之，沙池又次之。

translations.literal: Three deng vessels are set between baskets and trays; three xing vessels next; two fu and two gui next; fu on the left and gui on the right; seven meat stands south of the fu and gui; one incense table next; a sand basin next again.
translations.idiomatic: Three deng vessels stand between the baskets and trays, three xing vessels next, then two fu and two gui with fu on the left and gui on the right. Seven meat stands are south of the fu and gui, then one incense table and a sand basin.

sentences.zh: 又設每室尊罍於通廊，斝彜、黃彜各一，春夏用雞彜、鳥彜、犧尊二、象尊二，秋冬用著尊、壺尊，著尊二、山罍二，以次在本室南之左，皆加勺冪。

translations.literal: Wine vessels for each chamber are also set in the connecting corridor: one jia vessel and one yellow vessel; in spring and summer, chicken, bird, sacrificial, and elephant vessels—two sacrificial and two elephant; in autumn and winter, zhu and hu vessels—two zhu and two mountain urns—placed in order to the left south of the chamber, all with ladles and coverings.
translations.idiomatic: Wine vessels for each chamber are also set in the connecting corridor: one jia vessel and one yellow vessel. In spring and summer there are chicken, bird, sacrificial, and elephant vessels—two sacrificial and two elephant; in autumn and winter, zhu and hu vessels—two zhu and two mountain urns—placed in order to the left south of the chamber, each with its ladle and covering.

sentences.zh: 為酌尊所，北向，西上。

translations.literal: As the place for pouring wine vessels, facing north, with west as superior.
translations.idiomatic: This is the station for pouring from the wine vessels, facing north, with the western position superior.

sentences.zh: 彜有舟坫冪。

translations.literal: The yi vessels have boat-shaped stands, mats, and coverings.
translations.idiomatic: Each yi vessel has a boat-shaped stand, a mat, and a covering.

sentences.zh: 又設壺尊二、太尊二、山罍四，在殿下階間，俱北向，望室戶之左，皆有坫加冪，設而不酌。

translations.literal: Two hu wine vessels, two grand vessels, and four mountain urns are also set in the space between the steps below the hall, all facing north, to the left as one faces the chamber doors; each has a mat and covering added, set out but not poured from.
translations.idiomatic: Two hu wine vessels, two grand vessels, and four mountain urns are also placed between the steps below the hall, all facing north to the left of the chamber doors. Each has a mat and covering and is set out but not poured from.

sentences.zh: 凡祭器，皆藉以席。

translations.literal: All sacrificial vessels are spread with mats beneath them.
translations.idiomatic: All sacrificial vessels are laid on mats.

sentences.zh: 又設七祀位於橫階之南道東，西向，以北為上。

translations.literal: The places for the seven sacrifices are also set east of the path south of the cross steps, facing west, with north as superior.
translations.idiomatic: The stations for the seven sacrifices are also set east of the path south of the cross steps, facing west, with the northern position superior.

sentences.zh: 席皆以莞。

translations.literal: All mats are of cattail.
translations.idiomatic: All mats are made of cattail.

sentences.zh: 設神版位，各於座首。

translations.literal: Spirit tablet places are set, each at the head of its seat.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit tablet stations are set, each at the head of its seat.

sentences.zh: 又設祭器，每位左二籩，右二豆，簠一、簋一在籩豆間，俎一在籩前，爵坫一次之，壺尊二在神位之西，東向以北為上，皆有坫勺冪。

translations.literal: Sacrificial vessels are also set: for each place, two baskets on the left and two trays on the right; one fu and one gui between baskets and trays; one meat stand before the baskets; one libation cup and mat next; two hu wine vessels west of the spirit seat, facing east with north as superior—all with mats, ladles, and coverings.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial vessels are also arranged at each station: two baskets on the left and two trays on the right; one fu and one gui between the baskets and trays; one meat stand before the baskets; one libation cup and mat beside it; and two hu wine vessels west of the spirit seat, facing east with the northern position superior. Each has its mat, ladle, and covering.

sentences.zh: 又設三獻盥洗、爵洗在通街之西，橫街之南，北向。

translations.literal: Hand-washing and libation-cup washing places for the three offering officers are also set west of the main street and south of the cross street, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Hand-washing and libation-cup washing stations for the three offering officers are also set west of the main street and south of the cross street, facing north.

sentences.zh: 罍在洗西加勺，篚在洗東，皆實以巾。

translations.literal: The urn is west of the wash with a ladle added; the basket is east of the wash; both are filled with towels.
translations.idiomatic: The urn stands west of the wash with a ladle placed in it; the basket stands east of the wash. Both are filled with towels.

sentences.zh: 爵洗仍實以瓚，爵加盤坫。

translations.literal: The libation-cup washing place is still filled with a libation vessel; the cup is placed on a tray and mat.
translations.idiomatic: The libation-cup washing station is furnished with a libation vessel, and the cup is set on a tray and mat.

sentences.zh: 執罍篚者各位於後。

translations.literal: Those holding the urn and basket each take their places behind.
translations.idiomatic: Those who hold the urn and basket take their stations behind.

sentences.zh: 又設七祀獻官盥洗位於七祀神位前，稍北。

translations.literal: A hand-washing place for the seven-sacrifice offering officers is also set before the seven-sacrifice spirit seats, slightly to the north.
translations.idiomatic: A hand-washing station for the seven-sacrifice offering officers is also set before the seven-sacrifice spirit seats, slightly to the north.

sentences.zh: 罍在洗西，篚在洗東，實以巾。

translations.literal: The urn is west of the wash; the basket is east of the wash; both are filled with towels.
translations.idiomatic: The urn stands west of the wash and the basket east of it, both filled with towels.

sentences.zh: 又實爵於坫。

translations.literal: The libation cup is also filled and placed on the mat.
translations.idiomatic: The libation cup is also filled and set on its mat.

sentences.zh: 執罍篚者各位於後。

translations.literal: Those holding the urn and basket each take their places behind.
translations.idiomatic: Those who hold the urn and basket take their stations behind.

sentences.zh: 三曰習儀。

translations.literal: The third is rehearsing the ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The third stage is ritual rehearsal.

sentences.zh: 享前二日，三獻以下諸執事官員赴太廟習儀。

translations.literal: Two days before the offering, all officiating officials from the three offering officers downward go to the Imperial Ancestral Temple to rehearse the ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Two days before the sacrifice, all officiating officials from the three offering officers downward go to the Imperial Ancestral Temple to rehearse the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 次日早，各具公服乘馬赴東華門，迎接禦香至廟省牲。

translations.literal: Early the next morning, each in official dress mounts a horse and goes to the Donghua Gate to receive the imperial incense and proceed to the temple to inspect the victims.
translations.idiomatic: Early the next morning, each dons official dress, mounts a horse, and goes to the Donghua Gate to receive the imperial incense and proceed to the temple to inspect the sacrificial victims.

sentences.zh: 四曰迎香。

translations.literal: The fourth is receiving the incense.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth stage is receiving the imperial incense.

sentences.zh: 享前一日，有司告諭坊市，灑掃經行衢路，祗備香案。

translations.literal: One day before the offering, the responsible offices notify the wards and markets, sprinkle and sweep the procession route, and reverently prepare incense tables.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of the sacrifice, the responsible offices notify the wards and markets, sprinkle and sweep the procession route, and reverently prepare the incense tables.

sentences.zh: 享前一日質明，三獻官以下及諸執事官，各具公服，六品以下官皆借紫服，詣崇天門下。

translations.literal: At dawn one day before the offering, the three offering officers and all officiating officials below them, each in official dress—officials below the sixth rank all borrowing purple robes—proceed to below the Chongtian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on the eve of the sacrifice, the three offering officers and all officiating officials below them assemble in official dress; officials below the sixth rank borrow purple robes and proceed to the Chongtian Gate.

sentences.zh: 太常禮儀院官一員奉御香，一員奉酒，二員奉馬湩，自內出；

translations.literal: One official of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual carries the imperial incense; one carries wine; two carry mare's milk, coming from within the palace;
translations.idiomatic: One official of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual carries the imperial incense, one carries wine, and two carry mare's milk, coming from within the palace;

sentences.zh: 監祭、監禮、奉禮郎、太祝，分兩班前導；

translations.literal: the Supervising Sacrifice, Supervising Ritual, Ritual Gentleman, and Chief Sacrificer lead in two ranks;
translations.idiomatic: the Supervising Sacrifice, Supervising Ritual, Ritual Gentleman, and Chief Sacrificer lead the way in two ranks;

sentences.zh: 控鶴五人，一人執傘，從者四人，執儀仗在前行。

translations.literal: Five Crane Controllers—one holding a parasol and four attendants—carry the ceremonial guards and march ahead.
translations.idiomatic: Five Crane Controllers—one holding a parasol and four attendants—carry the ceremonial guards and march at the head of the procession.

sentences.zh: 至大明門，由正門出，教坊大樂作。

translations.literal: Upon reaching the Daming Gate, they exit by the main gate; the Capital Music Office grand music begins.
translations.idiomatic: When they reach the Daming Gate, they exit through the main gate as the Capital Music Office grand ensemble begins to play.

sentences.zh: 至崇天門外，奉香、酒、馬湩者安置於輿，導引如前。

translations.literal: Outside the Chongtian Gate, those bearing the incense, wine, and mare's milk place them on the palanquin; the escort proceeds as before.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Chongtian Gate, those bearing the incense, wine, and mare's milk place them on the palanquin, and the procession continues as before.

sentences.zh: 行至外垣欞星門外，百官上馬，分兩班行於儀仗之外，清道官行於儀衛之先，兵馬司之兵夾道次之，金鼓又次之，京尹儀從又次之，教坊大樂為一隊次之。

translations.literal: When they reach outside the Spirit Star Gate of the outer wall, all officials mount their horses and proceed in two ranks outside the ceremonial guards; the road-clearing officer goes before the ceremonial escort; soldiers of the Bureau of Military Affairs line both sides of the road next; gongs and drums follow; the metropolitan magistrate's retinue follows again; and the Capital Music Office grand music forms one company after that.
translations.idiomatic: When they reach the Spirit Star Gate of the outer wall, all officials mount their horses and proceed in two ranks outside the ceremonial guards. The road-clearing officer goes ahead of the ceremonial escort, followed by soldiers of the Bureau of Military Affairs lining both sides of the road, then gongs and drums, then the metropolitan magistrate's retinue, and finally the Capital Music Office grand ensemble as one company.

sentences.zh: 控鶴弩手各服其服，執儀仗左右成列次之，拱衛使居其中，儀鳳司細樂又次之。

translations.literal: Crane Controller archers each wear their proper dress, carry the ceremonial guards, and form ranks left and right next; the Commander of the Imperial Guard is in their midst; the Office of Ceremonial Music fine ensemble follows again.
translations.idiomatic: Crane Controller archers, each in proper dress, carry the ceremonial guards and form ranks to left and right. The Commander of the Imperial Guard rides among them, followed by the fine ensemble of the Office of Ceremonial Music.

sentences.zh: 太常卿與博士、御史導於輿前，獻官、司徒、大禮使、助奠官從入至殿下。

translations.literal: The Minister of Imperial Rites, together with the Erudite and Censor, leads before the palanquin; the offering officers, Minister of Education, Grand Master of Rites, and subsidiary offering officers follow in and enter to below the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Imperial Rites, together with the Erudite and Censor, leads before the palanquin. The offering officers, Minister of Education, Grand Master of Rites, and subsidiary offering officers follow in to below the hall.

sentences.zh: 獻官奉香酒馬湩升自東階，入殿內通廊正位安置。

translations.literal: The offering officers carry the incense, wine, and mare's milk up the eastern steps, enter the connecting corridor within the hall, and set them in their proper places.
translations.idiomatic: The offering officers carry the incense, wine, and mare's milk up the eastern steps, enter the connecting corridor within the hall, and set them in place.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引獻官降自東階，由東神門北偏門出，釋服。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the offering officers down the eastern steps, exit through the northern side gate of the eastern spirit gate, and change out of their ceremonial dress.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the offering officers down the eastern steps, out through the northern side gate of the eastern spirit gate, where they change out of their ceremonial dress.

sentences.zh: 五曰省牲器，見親祀儀。

translations.literal: The fifth is inspecting the sacrificial victims and vessels; see the ceremony for personal imperial sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth stage is the inspection of sacrificial victims and vessels, as prescribed in the personal imperial sacrifice ceremony.

sentences.zh: 六曰晨祼。

translations.literal: The sixth is the morning libation.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth stage is the morning libation.

sentences.zh: 祀日醜前五刻，太常卿、光祿卿、太廟令率其屬設燭於神位，遂同三獻官、司徒、大禮使等每室一人，分設禦香酒醴，以金玉爵斝，酌馬湩、葡萄尚醞酒奠於神案。

translations.literal: On the day of the sacrifice, five quarters before the chou hour of the third watch, the Minister of Imperial Rites, Minister of Imperial Household Supplies, and Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple lead their subordinates in setting candles at the spirit seats; then together with the three offering officers, Minister of Education, Grand Master of Rites, and others—one person per chamber—they separately set out imperial incense, wine, and sweet wine, and with jade and gold cups and jia vessels pour mare's milk and fine imperial grape wine and place them on the spirit tables.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of the sacrifice, five quarters before the chou hour of the third watch, the Minister of Imperial Rites, Minister of Imperial Household Supplies, and Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple lead their subordinates in lighting candles at the spirit seats. Then, together with the three offering officers, the Minister of Education, the Grand Master of Rites, and others—one person per chamber—they set out imperial incense, wine, and sweet wine. With jade and gold cups and jia vessels they pour mare's milk and fine imperial grape wine and place them on the spirit tables.

sentences.zh: 又陳籩豆之實。

translations.literal: The contents of the baskets and trays are also set out.
translations.idiomatic: The basket and tray offerings are also arranged.

sentences.zh: 籩四行，以右為上。

translations.literal: The baskets are in four rows, with right as superior.
translations.idiomatic: The baskets are arranged in four rows, with the right-hand position superior.

sentences.zh: 第一行，魚鱐在前，糗餌、粉餈次之。

translations.literal: In the first row, dried fish is first; roasted grain cakes and rice-flour cakes come next.
translations.idiomatic: In the first row, dried fish comes first, followed by roasted grain cakes and rice-flour cakes.

sentences.zh: 第二行，乾䕩在前，乾棗、形鹽次之。

translations.literal: In the second row, dried 䕩 is first; dried dates and molded salt come next.
translations.idiomatic: In the second row, dried 䕩 comes first, followed by dried dates and molded salt.

sentences.chineseCharacterReason: Rare ritual food term preserved because the graph 䕩 is opaque and prior English renderings were inconsistent.

sentences.zh: 第三行，鹿脯在前，榛實、乾桃次之。

translations.literal: In the third row, dried venison is first; hazelnuts and dried peaches come next.
translations.idiomatic: In the third row, dried venison comes first, followed by hazelnuts and dried peaches.

sentences.zh: 第四行，菱在前，芡、栗次之。

translations.literal: In the fourth row, water caltrops are first; fox nuts and chestnuts come next.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth row, water caltrops come first, followed by fox nuts and chestnuts.

sentences.zh: 豆四行，以左為上。

translations.literal: The trays are in four rows, with left as superior.
translations.idiomatic: The trays are arranged in four rows, with the left-hand position superior.

sentences.zh: 第一行，芹菹在前，筍菹、葵菹次之。

translations.literal: In the first row, pickled celery is first; pickled bamboo shoots and pickled mallow come next.
translations.idiomatic: In the first row, pickled celery comes first, followed by pickled bamboo shoots and pickled mallow.

sentences.zh: 第二行，菁菹在前，韭菹、厓食次之。

translations.literal: In the second row, pickled water shield is first; pickled leeks and sliced cured meat come next.
translations.idiomatic: In the second row, pickled water shield comes first, followed by pickled leeks and sliced cured meat.

sentences.zh: 第三行，魚醢在前，兔醢、豚拍次之。

translations.literal: In the third row, fish paste is first; rabbit paste and pork slices come next.
translations.idiomatic: In the third row, fish paste comes first, followed by rabbit paste and pork slices.

sentences.zh: 第四行，鹿臡在前，醓醢、糝食次之。

translations.literal: In the fourth row, minced venison is first; mixed paste and scattered grain food come next.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth row, minced venison comes first, followed by mixed paste and scattered grain food.

sentences.zh: 簠實以稻粱，簋實以黍稷，登實以太羹，铏實以和羹，尊彜、斝彜實以明水，黃彜實以郁鬯，犧尊實以泛齊，象尊實以醴齊，著尊實以盎齊，山罍實以三酒，壺尊實以醍齊，太尊實以沈齊。

translations.literal: The fu is filled with rice and millet; the gui with panicled millet and glutinous millet; the deng with plain broth; the xing with seasoned broth; the zun yi and jia yi with clear water; the yellow yi with aromatic ceremonial wine; the sacrificial zun with first fermentation; the elephant zun with second fermentation; the zhu zun with third fermentation; the mountain urn with the three wines; the hu zun with clarified fermentation; the grand zun with settled fermentation.
translations.idiomatic: The fu is filled with rice and millet, the gui with panicled and glutinous millet, the deng with plain broth, and the xing with seasoned broth. The zun yi and jia yi hold clear water; the yellow yi holds aromatic ceremonial wine; the sacrificial zun holds first fermentation; the elephant zun holds second fermentation; the zhu zun holds third fermentation; the mountain urn holds the three wines; the hu zun holds clarified fermentation; and the grand zun holds settled fermentation.

sentences.zh: 凡齊之上尊實以明水，酒之上尊實以玄酒，其酒齊皆以上醞代之。

translations.literal: For all fermented beverages, the upper vessels are filled with clear water; for wine, the upper vessels are filled with dark liquor; all fermented beverages are substituted with fine imperial wine.
translations.idiomatic: For all fermented beverages, the upper vessels are filled with clear water; for wine, the upper vessels are filled with dark liquor. All fermented beverages are replaced with fine imperial wine.

sentences.zh: 又實七祀之祭器，每位左二籩，栗在前，鹿脯次之；

translations.literal: The sacrificial vessels for the seven sacrifices are also filled: for each place, two baskets on the left—chestnuts first, dried venison next;
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial vessels for the seven sacrifices are also filled. At each station, two baskets on the left hold chestnuts first and dried venison next;

sentences.zh: 右二豆，菁菹在前，鹿臡次之。

translations.literal: two trays on the right—pickled water shield first, minced venison next.
translations.idiomatic: and two trays on the right hold pickled water shield first and minced venison next.

sentences.zh: 簠實以黍，簋實以稷，壺尊實以醍齊，其酒齊亦以上醞代之。

translations.literal: The fu is filled with panicled millet; the gui with glutinous millet; the hu zun with clarified fermentation; its fermented beverages are also substituted with fine imperial wine.
translations.idiomatic: The fu is filled with panicled millet, the gui with glutinous millet, and the hu zun with clarified fermentation; its fermented beverages are also replaced with fine imperial wine.

sentences.zh: 陳設訖，獻官以下行事執事官，各服其服，會於齊班廳。

translations.literal: When the arrangement is complete, the offering officers and all officiating officials below them, each in proper dress, assemble in the fasting hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the arrangement is complete, the offering officers and all officiating officials below them, each in proper dress, assemble in the fasting hall.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引太常卿、監祭、監禮、太廟令、太祝、宮闈令、諸執事官、齋郎，自南神門東偏門入就位，東西相向立定。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the Minister of Imperial Rites, Supervising Sacrifice, Supervising Ritual, Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, Chief Sacrificer, Director of Palace Inner Quarters, various officiating officials, and fasting officers in through the eastern side gate of the southern spirit gate to take their places, standing facing each other east and west.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the Minister of Imperial Rites, Supervising Sacrifice, Supervising Ritual, Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, Chief Sacrificer, Director of Palace Inner Quarters, various officiating officials, and fasting officers in through the eastern side gate of the southern spirit gate. They take their places and stand facing each other east and west.

sentences.zh: 候監祭、監禮按視殿之上下，徹去蓋冪，糾察不如儀者，退復位。

translations.literal: They wait while the Supervising Sacrifice and Supervising Ritual inspect above and below the hall, remove the coverings, correct those not in accord with ritual, withdraw, and return to their places.
translations.idiomatic: They wait while the Supervising Sacrifice and Supervising Ritual inspect the hall above and below, remove the coverings, and correct any irregularities. They then withdraw and return to their stations.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引太常卿、監祭、監禮、太廟令、太祝、宮闈令升自東階，詣太祖室。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the Minister of Imperial Rites, Supervising Sacrifice, Supervising Ritual, Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, Chief Sacrificer, and Director of Palace Inner Quarters up the eastern steps to the chamber of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the Minister of Imperial Rites, Supervising Sacrifice, Supervising Ritual, Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, Chief Sacrificer, and Director of Palace Inner Quarters up the eastern steps to the chamber of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 蒙古太祝起帝主神冪，宮闈令起後主神冪。

translations.literal: The Mongol Chief Sacrificer lifts the coverings on the spirit tablets of the emperors; the Director of Palace Inner Quarters lifts the coverings on the spirit tablets of the empresses.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol Chief Sacrificer lifts the coverings on the emperors' spirit tablets, and the Director of Palace Inner Quarters lifts the coverings on the empresses' spirit tablets.

sentences.zh: 次詣每室，並如常儀畢，禮直官引太常卿以下諸執事官，當橫街間，重行，以西為上，北向立定。

translations.literal: Next they proceed to each chamber, all according to the usual ritual; when this is complete, the ritual attendants lead the Minister of Imperial Rites and the various officiating officials below him to stand in the cross street in double ranks, with west as superior, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: They then proceed to each chamber in turn, following the usual procedure throughout. When this is complete, the ritual attendants lead the Minister of Imperial Rites and the officiating officials below him to stand in the cross street in double ranks, facing north with the western position superior.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎贊曰「奉神主訖，再拜」。

translations.literal: The Ritual Gentleman announces, "The presentation of the spirit tablets is complete; bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Gentleman calls, "The spirit tablets have been presented. Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 禮直承傳，太常卿以下皆再拜訖，奉禮郎又贊曰「各就位」。

translations.literal: The ritual attendant receives and relays it; from the Minister of Imperial Rites downward all bow twice; when this is complete, the Ritual Gentleman again announces, "Each take your place."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendant relays the command. From the Minister of Imperial Rites downward, all perform the double bow. When this is done, the Ritual Gentleman calls again, "Each take your place."

sentences.zh: 禮直官引諸執事官各就位，次引太官令率齋郎由南神門東偏門以次出。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the various officiating officials each to his place; next they lead the Director of Imperial Kitchens, at the head of the fasting officers, out in order through the eastern side gate of the southern spirit gate.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the various officiating officials to their stations, then lead the Director of the Imperial Kitchens and the fasting officers out in order through the eastern side gate of the southern spirit gate.

sentences.zh: 贊者引三獻官、司徒、大禮使、七祀獻官、諸行事官，由南神門東偏門入，各就位，立定。

translations.literal: The announcer leads the three offering officers, Minister of Education, Grand Master of Rites, seven-sacrifice offering officers, and various ceremonial officials in through the eastern side gate of the southern spirit gate; each takes his place and stands in position.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer escorts the three offering officers, Minister of Education, Grand Master of Rites, seven-sacrifice offering officers, and ceremonial officials in through the eastern side gate of the southern spirit gate. Each takes his station and stands at attention.

sentences.zh: 禮直官進於初獻官之左，贊曰「有司謹具，請行事」，退復位。

translations.literal: The ritual attendant advances to the left of the chief offering officer and announces, "The offices have reverently prepared; please proceed with the ceremony"; he withdraws and returns to his place.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendant advances to the left of the chief offering officer and announces, "The offices have reverently prepared everything. Please proceed with the ceremony." He then withdraws and returns to his station.

sentences.zh: 協律郎跪，俯伏興，舉麾興工鼓，宮縣樂奏《思成之曲》九成，文舞九變。

translations.literal: The Pitch Master kneels, prostrates himself and rises, raises the baton and signals the artisans to beat the drums; the palace ensemble performs the "Song of Reflective Completion" in nine sections; the civil dance undergoes nine changes.
translations.idiomatic: The Pitch Master kneels, prostrates himself, and rises. He raises his baton and signals the musicians to strike the drums. The palace ensemble performs the "Song of Reflective Completion" in nine sections, and the civil dance runs through nine changes.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎贊再拜，在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: The Ritual Gentleman announces bow twice; all who are in position bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Gentleman calls for the double bow, and everyone in attendance performs it.

sentences.zh: 奉禮又贊諸執事者各就位，禮直官引奉瓚、奉爵、盥爵、洗巾篚執事官各就位，立定。

translations.literal: The Ritual Gentleman again announces that the various officiants each take their places; the ritual attendants lead the officiants who present the libation vessel, present the cup, wash the cup, and hold the towel and basket each to his place and stand in position.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Gentleman again calls for the officiants to take their places. The ritual attendants escort the officiants who present the libation vessel, present the cup, wash the cup, and hold the towel and basket to their stations, where they stand at attention.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引初獻官詣盥洗位，宮縣樂作無射宮《肅寧之曲》，至位北向立定；

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the chief offering officer to the hand-washing place; the palace ensemble plays the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the wushe mode; when he reaches his place he stands facing north;
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the chief offering officer to the hand-washing station. The palace ensemble plays the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the wushe mode. When he reaches his place, he stands facing north;

sentences.zh: 搢笏、盥手、帨手，執笏詣爵洗位，至位北向立定；

translations.literal: he inserts his tablet, washes his hands, and dries his hands; holding his tablet he goes to the libation-cup washing place and, when he reaches his place, stands facing north;
translations.idiomatic: inserts his tablet, washes his hands, and dries them; holding his tablet, he proceeds to the libation-cup washing station and stands facing north;

sentences.zh: 搢笏、執瓚、洗瓚、拭瓚，以瓚授執事者。

translations.literal: he inserts his tablet, takes the libation vessel, washes the libation vessel, wipes the libation vessel, and hands the libation vessel to an officiant.
translations.idiomatic: inserts his tablet, takes the libation vessel, washes and wipes it, and hands it to an officiant.

sentences.zh: 執笏，樂止。

translations.literal: Holding his tablet, the music stops.
translations.idiomatic: Tablet in hand, he waits as the music stops.

sentences.zh: 登歌樂作，奏夾鐘宮《肅寧之曲》，升自東階，樂止。

translations.literal: The ascent music begins, performing the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the jiazhong mode; he ascends by the eastern steps; the music stops.
translations.idiomatic: The ascent music begins, playing the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the jiazhong mode. He ascends the eastern steps, and the music stops.

sentences.zh: 詣太祖酌尊所，西向立，搢笏，執事者以瓚授初獻官，執瓚。

translations.literal: He proceeds to the place for pouring wine vessels for Taizu, stands facing west, inserts his tablet; an officiant hands the libation vessel to the chief offering officer, who holds the libation vessel.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeds to the wine-pouring station for Taizu and stands facing west. He inserts his tablet, and an officiant hands him the libation vessel, which he takes up.

sentences.zh: 司尊彜跪舉冪，良醞令跪酌黃彜郁鬯，初獻以瓚授執事者，執笏詣太祖神位前，北向立，搢笏跪，三上香。

translations.literal: The wine-vessel steward kneels and lifts the covering; the Director of Fine Brew kneels and pours aromatic ceremonial wine from the yellow yi; the chief offering officer hands the libation vessel to an officiant; holding his tablet he proceeds before the spirit seat of Taizu, stands facing north, inserts his tablet and kneels, and offers incense three times.
translations.idiomatic: The wine-vessel steward kneels and lifts the covering. The Director of Fine Brew kneels and pours aromatic ceremonial wine from the yellow yi. The chief offering officer hands the libation vessel to an officiant, then, tablet in hand, proceeds before the spirit seat of Taizu, stands facing north, inserts his tablet, kneels, and offers incense three times.

sentences.zh: 執事者以瓚授初獻，初獻執瓚以鬯灌於沙池，以瓚授執事者，執笏，俯伏興，出室戶外，北向立。

translations.literal: An officiant hands the libation vessel to the chief offering officer; the chief offering officer holds the libation vessel and pours the aromatic wine into the sand basin; he hands the libation vessel to an officiant; holding his tablet he prostrates himself and rises, withdraws outside the chamber door, and stands facing north.
translations.idiomatic: An officiant presents the libation vessel to the chief offering officer, who pours the aromatic wine into the sand basin, then returns the vessel to the officiant. Tablet in hand, he prostrates himself and rises, withdraws outside the chamber door, and stands facing north.

sentences.zh: 再拜訖，詣每室祼鬯如上儀。

translations.literal: When he has bowed twice, he proceeds to each chamber and performs the libation of aromatic wine according to the ritual above.
translations.idiomatic: After performing the double bow, he proceeds to each chamber in turn and performs the libation of aromatic wine according to the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，禮直官引初獻降自東階，登歌樂作，奏夾鐘宮《肅寧之曲》。

translations.literal: When all is complete, the ritual attendants lead the chief offering officer down the eastern steps; the ascent music begins, performing the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the jiazhong mode.
translations.idiomatic: When all is complete, the ritual attendants escort the chief offering officer down the eastern steps as the ascent music begins, playing the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the jiazhong mode.

sentences.zh: 復位，樂止。

translations.literal: He returns to his place; the music stops.
translations.idiomatic: He returns to his station, and the music stops.

sentences.zh: 七曰饋食。

translations.literal: The seventh is presenting the food offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh stage is presenting the food offerings.

sentences.zh: 初獻既祼，如前進饌儀。

translations.literal: When the chief offering officer has completed the libation, the food offerings are presented as in the earlier procedure for advancing the feast.
translations.idiomatic: Once the chief offering officer has completed the libation, the food offerings are presented according to the procedure for advancing the feast described above.

sentences.zh: 八曰酌獻。

translations.literal: The eighth is pouring and offering wine.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth stage is pouring and offering wine.

sentences.zh: 太祝立茅苴於盤。

translations.literal: The Chief Sacrificer sets the thatch bundle upright in a tray.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Sacrificer sets the thatch bundle upright in a tray.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引初獻詣盥洗位，宮縣樂作，奏無射宮《肅寧之曲》，至位北向立；

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the chief offering officer to the hand-washing place; the palace ensemble plays, performing the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the wushe mode; when he reaches his place he stands facing north;
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the chief offering officer to the hand-washing station. The palace ensemble plays the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the wushe mode. When he reaches his place, he stands facing north;

sentences.zh: 搢笏、盥手、帨手，執笏詣爵洗位；

translations.literal: he inserts his tablet, washes his hands, and dries his hands; holding his tablet he goes to the libation-cup washing place;
translations.idiomatic: inserts his tablet, washes his hands, and dries them; holding his tablet, he proceeds to the libation-cup washing station;

sentences.zh: 至位，搢笏、執爵、洗爵、拭爵、以爵授執事者，執笏，樂止。

translations.literal: when he reaches his place, he inserts his tablet, takes the cup, washes the cup, wipes the cup, and hands the cup to an officiant; holding his tablet, the music stops.
translations.idiomatic: reaches his place, inserts his tablet, takes the cup, washes and wipes it, and hands it to an officiant. Tablet in hand, he waits as the music stops.

sentences.zh: 登歌樂作，奏夾鐘宮《肅寧之曲》。

translations.literal: The ascent music begins, performing the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the jiazhong mode.
translations.idiomatic: The ascent music begins, playing the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the jiazhong mode.

sentences.zh: 升自東階，樂止。

translations.literal: He ascends by the eastern steps; the music stops.
translations.idiomatic: He ascends the eastern steps, and the music stops.

sentences.zh: 詣太祖酒尊所，西向立，搢笏執爵。

translations.literal: He proceeds to the wine vessel place for Taizu, stands facing west, inserts his tablet, and holds the cup.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeds to the wine vessel station for Taizu, stands facing west, inserts his tablet, and takes up the cup.

sentences.zh: 司尊彜搢笏跪舉冪，良醞令搢笏跪酌犧尊之泛齊，以爵授執事者，執笏。

translations.literal: The wine-vessel steward inserts his tablet, kneels, and lifts the covering; the Director of Fine Brew inserts his tablet, kneels, and pours first fermentation from the sacrificial zun; he hands the cup to an officiant; holding his tablet.
translations.idiomatic: The wine-vessel steward inserts his tablet, kneels, and lifts the covering. The Director of Fine Brew inserts his tablet, kneels, and pours first fermentation from the sacrificial zun, then hands the cup to an officiant. The chief offering officer holds his tablet.

sentences.zh: 宮縣樂作，奏無射宮《開成之曲》。

translations.literal: The palace ensemble plays, performing the "Song of Opening Completion" in the wushe mode.
translations.idiomatic: The palace ensemble plays the "Song of Opening Completion" in the wushe mode.

sentences.zh: 詣太祖神座前，北向立，稍前，搢笏跪，三上香。

translations.literal: He proceeds before the spirit seat of Taizu, stands facing north, advances slightly, inserts his tablet and kneels, and offers incense three times.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeds before the spirit seat of Taizu, stands facing north, advances slightly, inserts his tablet, kneels, and offers incense three times.

sentences.zh: 執爵，三祭酒於茅苴，以爵授執事者，執笏，俯伏興，平立。

translations.literal: He holds the cup and offers libation wine three times on the thatch bundle; he hands the cup to an officiant; holding his tablet he prostrates himself and rises, and stands level.
translations.idiomatic: He takes the cup and pours libation wine three times on the thatch bundle, then hands the cup to an officiant. Tablet in hand, he prostrates himself and rises, and stands upright.

sentences.zh: 請出室戶外，北向立，樂止，俟讀祝。

translations.literal: He withdraws outside the chamber door, stands facing north; the music stops; he waits for the reading of the prayer.
translations.idiomatic: He withdraws outside the chamber door and stands facing north. The music stops, and he waits for the prayer to be read.

sentences.zh: 舉祝官搢笏跪，對舉祝版，讀祝官跪讀祝文。

translations.literal: The prayer-board officer inserts his tablet and kneels, holding up the prayer board opposite; the prayer-reading officer kneels and reads the prayer text.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer-board officer inserts his tablet and kneels, holding up the prayer board. The prayer-reading officer kneels and reads the prayer text.

sentences.zh: 讀訖，舉祝官奠祝版於案，執笏興，讀祝官俯伏興。

translations.literal: When the reading is complete, the prayer-board officer places the prayer board on the table, holds his tablet and rises; the prayer-reading officer prostrates himself and rises.
translations.idiomatic: When the reading is complete, the prayer-board officer places the prayer board on the table and rises, tablet in hand. The prayer-reading officer prostrates himself and rises.

sentences.zh: 禮直官贊再拜訖，次詣每室，酌獻如上儀，各奏本室之樂。

translations.literal: The ritual attendant announces bow twice; when this is complete, he next proceeds to each chamber and pours and offers wine according to the ritual above, each chamber performing its own music.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendant calls for the double bow. The chief offering officer then proceeds to each chamber in turn and pours and offers wine according to the same procedure, with each chamber's own music performed.

sentences.zh: 獻畢，宮縣樂止。

translations.literal: When the offerings are complete, the palace ensemble music stops.
translations.idiomatic: When the offerings are complete, the palace ensemble music stops.

sentences.zh: 降自東階，登歌樂作，奏夾鐘宮《肅寧之曲》。

translations.literal: He descends by the eastern steps; the ascent music begins, performing the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the jiazhong mode.
translations.idiomatic: He descends the eastern steps as the ascent music begins, playing the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the jiazhong mode.

sentences.zh: 初獻復位，立定。

translations.literal: The chief offering officer returns to his place and stands in position.
translations.idiomatic: The chief offering officer returns to his station and stands at attention.

sentences.zh: 文舞退，武舞進，宮縣樂作，奏無射宮《肅寧之曲》。

translations.literal: The civil dance withdraws; the martial dance advances; the palace ensemble plays, performing the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the wushe mode.
translations.idiomatic: The civil dance withdraws and the martial dance advances. The palace ensemble plays the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the wushe mode.

sentences.zh: 舞者立定，樂止。

translations.literal: The dancers stand in position; the music stops.
translations.idiomatic: The dancers stand at attention, and the music stops.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引亞獻詣盥洗位，至位北向立，搢笏、執爵、洗爵、拭爵，以爵授執事者。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the secondary offering officer to the hand-washing place; when he reaches his place he stands facing north; he inserts his tablet, takes the cup, washes the cup, wipes the cup, and hands the cup to an officiant.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the secondary offering officer to the hand-washing station. When he reaches his place, he stands facing north, inserts his tablet, takes the cup, washes and wipes it, and hands it to an officiant.

sentences.zh: 升自東階，詣太祖酌尊所，西向立，搢笏，執爵。

translations.literal: He ascends by the eastern steps, proceeds to the place for pouring wine vessels for Taizu, stands facing west, inserts his tablet, and holds the cup.
translations.idiomatic: He ascends the eastern steps, proceeds to the wine-pouring station for Taizu, stands facing west, inserts his tablet, and takes up the cup.

sentences.zh: 司尊彜搢笏跪舉冪，良醞令搢笏跪酌象尊之醴齊，以爵授執事者，執笏。

translations.literal: The wine-vessel steward inserts his tablet, kneels, and lifts the covering; the Director of Fine Brew inserts his tablet, kneels, and pours second fermentation from the elephant zun; he hands the cup to an officiant; holding his tablet.
translations.idiomatic: The wine-vessel steward inserts his tablet, kneels, and lifts the covering. The Director of Fine Brew inserts his tablet, kneels, and pours second fermentation from the elephant zun, then hands the cup to an officiant. The secondary offering officer holds his tablet.

sentences.zh: 宮縣樂作，奏無射宮《肅寧之曲》。

translations.literal: The palace ensemble plays, performing the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the wushe mode.
translations.idiomatic: The palace ensemble plays the "Song of Solemn Tranquility" in the wushe mode.

sentences.zh: 詣太祖神座前，北向立，稍前，搢笏跪，三上香，執爵三祭酒於茅苴，以爵授執事者，執笏俯伏興，平立，請出室戶外，北向立。

translations.literal: He proceeds before the spirit seat of Taizu, stands facing north, advances slightly, inserts his tablet and kneels, offers incense three times, holds the cup and offers libation wine three times on the thatch bundle, hands the cup to an officiant, holding his tablet prostrates himself and rises, stands level, withdraws outside the chamber door, and stands facing north.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeds before the spirit seat of Taizu, stands facing north, advances slightly, inserts his tablet, kneels, and offers incense three times. He takes the cup and pours libation wine three times on the thatch bundle, then hands the cup to an officiant. Tablet in hand, he prostrates himself and rises, stands upright, withdraws outside the chamber door, and stands facing north.

sentences.zh: 再拜訖，次詣每室，酌獻並如上儀。

translations.literal: When he has bowed twice, he next proceeds to each chamber and pours and offers wine, all according to the ritual above.
translations.idiomatic: After performing the double bow, he proceeds to each chamber in turn and pours and offers wine according to the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 獻畢，樂止。

translations.literal: When the offerings are complete, the music stops.
translations.idiomatic: When the offerings are complete, the music stops.

sentences.zh: 降自東階，復位立定。

translations.literal: He descends by the eastern steps, returns to his place, and stands in position.
translations.idiomatic: He descends the eastern steps, returns to his station, and stands at attention.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引終獻，如亞獻之儀，唯酌著尊之盎齊。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the final offering officer, according to the ritual of the secondary offering officer, only pouring third fermentation from the zhuan zun.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the final offering officer through the same procedure as the secondary offering officer, except that he pours third fermentation from the zhuan zun.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，降復位。

translations.literal: When the ritual is complete, he descends and returns to his place.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite is complete, he descends and returns to his station.

sentences.zh: 初終獻將行，贊者引七祀獻官詣盥洗位，搢笏、盥手、帨手訖，執笏詣酒尊所，搢笏、執爵、酌酒，以爵授執事者，執笏詣首位神座前，東向立，稍前，搢笏跪執爵，三祭酒於沙池，奠爵於案，執笏俯伏興，少退立，再拜訖，每位並如上儀。

translations.literal: When the chief and final offerings are about to begin, the announcer leads the seven subsidiary offering officers for the seven sacrifices to the hand-washing place; they insert their tablets, wash their hands, and dry their hands; holding their tablets they proceed to the wine vessel place, insert their tablets, take the cup, and pour wine; they hand the cup to an officiant; holding their tablets they proceed before the spirit seat of the first position, stand facing east, advance slightly, insert their tablets and kneel while holding the cup, offer libation wine three times in the sand basin, set the cup on the table, holding their tablets prostrate themselves and rise, withdraw slightly and stand, bow twice; for each position all is according to the ritual above.
translations.idiomatic: When the chief and final offerings are about to begin, the announcer escorts the seven subsidiary offering officers for the seven sacrifices to the hand-washing station. They insert their tablets, wash and dry their hands, then proceed to the wine vessel station, insert their tablets, take the cup, and pour wine, handing it to an officiant. Tablet in hand, each proceeds before the first spirit seat, stands facing east, advances slightly, inserts his tablet, kneels holding the cup, pours libation wine three times into the sand basin, and sets the cup on the table. He prostrates himself and rises, withdraws slightly, and performs the double bow. Each position follows the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，七祀獻官俟終獻官降復位，立定。

translations.literal: When all is complete, the seven-sacrifice offering officers wait for the final offering officer to descend and return to his place, and stand in position.
translations.idiomatic: When all is complete, the seven-sacrifice offering officers wait for the final offering officer to descend and return to his station, then stand at attention.

sentences.zh: 九曰祭馬湩。

translations.literal: The ninth is offering libation of kumiss.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth stage is the libation of kumiss.

sentences.zh: 終獻酌獻將畢，禮直官分引初獻亞獻官、司徒、太禮使、助奠官、七祀獻官、太常卿、監祭、監禮、太廟令丞、蒙古庖人、巫祝等升殿。

translations.literal: When the final offering's pouring and presentation is nearly complete, the ritual attendants separately lead the chief and secondary offering officers, Minister of Education, Grand Master of Rites, subsidiary offering officers, seven-sacrifice offering officers, Minister of Imperial Rites, Supervising Sacrifice Censor, Supervising Ritual Erudite, Director and Vice Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, Mongol butchers, shaman sacrificers, and others to ascend the hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the final offering's wine libation is nearly complete, the ritual attendants escort in groups the chief and secondary offering officers, the Minister of Education, the Grand Master of Rites, subsidiary offering officers, seven-sacrifice offering officers, the Minister of Imperial Rites, the Supervising Sacrifice Censor, the Supervising Ritual Erudite, the Director and Vice Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, Mongol butchers, shaman sacrificers, and others up the hall.

sentences.zh: 每室獻官一員，各立於戶外，太常卿、監祭、監禮以下立於其後。

translations.literal: One offering officer for each chamber stands outside the door; the Minister of Imperial Rites, Supervising Sacrifice Censor, Supervising Ritual Erudite, and those below stand behind them.
translations.idiomatic: One offering officer per chamber stands outside the door, with the Minister of Imperial Rites, the Supervising Sacrifice Censor, the Supervising Ritual Erudite, and those below standing behind them.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引獻官詣神座前，蒙古庖人割牲體以授獻官。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the offering officer before the spirit seat; the Mongol butcher cuts the sacrificial meat and hands it to the offering officer.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the offering officer before the spirit seat. The Mongol butcher cuts the sacrificial portion and hands it to the offering officer.

sentences.zh: 獻官搢笏跪奠於帝主神位前，次奠於後主神位前訖，出笏退就拜位，搢笏跪。

translations.literal: The offering officer inserts his tablet, kneels, and sets the offering before the emperor's spirit seat, then sets it before the empress's spirit seat; when this is complete he withdraws his tablet, retreats to the bowing place, inserts his tablet, and kneels.
translations.idiomatic: The offering officer inserts his tablet, kneels, and presents the offering before the emperor's spirit seat, then before the empress's spirit seat. When this is done, he withdraws his tablet, retreats to the bowing station, inserts his tablet, and kneels.

sentences.zh: 太廟令取案上先設金玉爵斝馬湩，蒲萄尚醞酒，以次授獻官，獻官皆祭於沙池。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple takes from the table the jade and gold cups, jia vessels, kumiss, and fine imperial grape wine previously set out, and in order hands them to the offering officers; the offering officers all pour libations in the sand basin.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple takes from the table the prearranged jade and gold cups, jia vessels, kumiss, and fine imperial grape wine and presents them in turn to the offering officers, who each pour libations into the sand basin.

sentences.zh: 蒙古巫祝致詞訖，宮縣樂作同進饌之曲。

translations.literal: When the Mongol shaman sacrificer has completed the offering prayer, the palace ensemble plays the song for jointly presenting the feast.
translations.idiomatic: When the Mongol shaman sacrificer has completed the offering invocation, the palace ensemble plays the "Song of Joint Presentation of the Feast."

sentences.zh: 初獻出笏就拜興，請出室戶外，北向立。

translations.literal: The chief offering officer withdraws his tablet, rises from the bow, withdraws outside the chamber door, and stands facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The chief offering officer withdraws his tablet, rises from his bow, withdraws outside the chamber door, and stands facing north.

sentences.zh: 俟眾獻官畢立，禮直官通贊曰「拜」，「興」，凡四拜。

translations.literal: When all the offering officers have finished standing in position, the ritual attendant announces in succession, "Bow," "Rise," for four bows in all.
translations.idiomatic: When all offering officers have taken their places, the ritual attendant calls in succession, "Bow" and "Rise," for a total of four bows.

sentences.zh: 監祭、監禮以下從拜。

translations.literal: From the Supervising Sacrifice Censor and Supervising Ritual Erudite downward, all join in the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The Supervising Sacrifice Censor, the Supervising Ritual Erudite, and all below them join in the bow.

sentences.zh: 皆作本朝跪禮。

translations.literal: All perform the kneeling obeisance of this dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: All perform the kneeling obeisance prescribed by this dynasty.

sentences.zh: 拜訖退，登歌樂作，降階，樂止。

translations.literal: When the bow is complete they withdraw; the ascent music begins; they descend the steps; the music stops.
translations.idiomatic: When the bow is complete, they withdraw. The ascent music begins as they descend the steps, then the music stops.

sentences.zh: 太祝徹籩豆，登歌樂作，奏夾鐘宮《豐寧之曲》。

translations.literal: The Chief Sacrificer removes the baskets and trays; the ascent music begins, performing the "Song of Abundant Tranquility" in the jiazhong mode.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Sacrificer removes the baskets and trays as the ascent music begins, playing the "Song of Abundant Tranquility" in the jiazhong mode.

sentences.zh: 奉禮贊賜胙，贊者承傳，眾官再拜興。

translations.literal: The Ritual Usher announces that the sacrificial portion is bestowed; the announcer receives and relays it; all the officials bow twice and rise.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Usher announces, "The sacrificial portion is bestowed." The announcer relays the command, and all officials perform the double bow and rise.

sentences.zh: 送神樂作，奏黃鐘宮《保成之曲》，一成而止。

translations.literal: The music for escorting the spirits plays, performing the "Song of Preserved Completion" in the huangzhong mode, in one section and stopping.
translations.idiomatic: The music for escorting the spirits begins, playing the "Song of Preserved Completion" in the huangzhong mode for one section and then stopping.

sentences.zh: 太祝各奉每室祝版，降自太階望瘞位，禮直官引三獻、司徒、大禮使、助奠、七祀獻官、太常卿、光祿卿、監祭、監禮視燔祝版，至位坎北南向跪，以祝版奠於柴，就拜興。

translations.literal: Each Chief Sacrificer carries the prayer boards for each chamber, descends the great steps toward the burial pit; the ritual attendants lead the three offering officers, Minister of Education, Grand Master of Rites, subsidiary offering officers, seven-sacrifice offering officers, Minister of Imperial Rites, Minister of Imperial Household Supplies, Supervising Sacrifice Censor, and Supervising Ritual Erudite to witness the burning of the prayer boards; arriving at the place north of the pit, facing south they kneel, set the prayer boards on the firewood, and rise from the bow.
translations.idiomatic: Each Chief Sacrificer carries the prayer boards for each chamber and descends the great steps toward the burial pit. The ritual attendants escort the three offering officers, the Minister of Education, the Grand Master of Rites, subsidiary offering officers, seven-sacrifice offering officers, the Minister of Imperial Rites, the Minister of Imperial Household Supplies, the Supervising Sacrifice Censor, and the Supervising Ritual Erudite to witness the burning of the prayer boards. At the place north of the pit, they kneel facing south, set the prayer boards on the firewood, and rise from their bow.

sentences.zh: 俟半燎，禮直官贊可瘞。

translations.literal: When half has been burned, the ritual attendant announces that burial may proceed.
translations.idiomatic: When the fire has burned halfway, the ritual attendant announces that burial may proceed.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引三獻以下及諸執事者齋郎等，由南神門東偏門出至揖位，圓揖。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead those from the three offering officers downward and the various officiants including purification attendants out through the eastern side gate of the southern spirit gate to the bowing place, and perform the circular bow.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the three offering officers and below, together with officiants including the purification attendants, out through the eastern side gate of the southern spirit gate to the bowing station, where they perform the circular bow.

sentences.zh: 樂工二舞以次從出。

translations.literal: The artisans of the two dances follow out in order.
translations.idiomatic: The performers of the two dances follow out in order.

sentences.zh: 三獻之出也，禮直官分引太常卿、太廟令、監祭、監禮、蒙古太祝、宮闈令及各室太祝，升自東階，詣太祖神座前，升納神主，每室如儀。

translations.literal: As the three offering officers depart, the ritual attendants separately lead the Minister of Imperial Rites, Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, Supervising Sacrifice Censor, Supervising Ritual Erudite, Mongol Chief Sacrificer, Director of Palace Inner Quarters, and Chief Sacrificers of each chamber up the eastern steps, proceed before the spirit seat of Taizu, ascend and return the spirit tablets—each chamber according to the ritual.
translations.idiomatic: As the three offering officers depart, the ritual attendants escort in groups the Minister of Imperial Rites, the Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the Supervising Sacrifice Censor, the Supervising Ritual Erudite, the Mongol Chief Sacrificer, the Director of Palace Inner Quarters, and the Chief Sacrificers of each chamber up the eastern steps. They proceed before the spirit seat of Taizu and return the spirit tablets, following the same procedure in each chamber.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，降自東階，至橫街南，北向西上立定。

translations.literal: When all is complete, they descend the eastern steps, reach south of the cross street, and stand facing north and west in position.
translations.idiomatic: When all is complete, they descend the eastern steps to south of the cross street and stand in position facing north, with the west as the superior direction.

sentences.zh: 奉禮贊曰「升納神主訖，再拜」。

translations.literal: The Ritual Usher announces, "The spirit tablets have been returned; bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Usher calls, "The spirit tablets have been returned. Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 贊者承傳，再拜訖，以次出。

translations.literal: The announcer receives and relays it; when the bow is complete they withdraw in order.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer relays the command. After the double bow, they withdraw in order.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，三獻官、司徒、大禮使、太常禮儀院使、光祿卿等官，奉胙進於闕庭。

translations.literal: When the ritual is complete, the three offering officers, Minister of Education, Grand Master of Rites, Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual, Minister of Imperial Household Supplies, and other officials carry the sacrificial portion and present it at the palace court.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite is complete, the three offering officers, the Minister of Education, the Grand Master of Rites, the Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual, the Minister of Imperial Household Supplies, and other officials carry the sacrificial portion and present it at the palace court.

sentences.zh: 駕幸上都，則以驛赴奉進。

translations.literal: When the emperor is at Shangdu, it is sent by courier post for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor is at Shangdu, the sacrificial portion is dispatched by courier for presentation.

sentences.zh: 攝行告謝儀：告前三日，三獻官以下諸執事官，各具公服赴中書省受誓戒。

translations.literal: Procedure for the deputy performance of the thanksgiving rite: three days before the announcement, all officiating officials from the three offering officers downward, each in official dress, go to the Central Secretariat to receive the abstention oath.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for the deputy performance of the thanksgiving rite: three days before the announcement, all officiating officials from the three offering officers downward, each in official dress, go to the Central Secretariat to receive the purification oath.

sentences.zh: 告前一日未正二刻，省牲器。

translations.literal: On the day before the announcement, at the second quarter before weizheng, the sacrificial victims and vessels are inspected.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of the announcement, at the second quarter before the weizheng hour, the sacrificial victims and vessels are inspected.

sentences.zh: 至期質明，三獻官以下諸執事者各服法服，禮直官引太常卿、監祭御史、監禮博士、五令諸執事官先入就位。

translations.literal: On the appointed day at dawn, all officiants from the three offering officers downward wear sacrificial robes; the ritual attendants lead the Minister of Imperial Rites, Supervising Sacrifice Censor, Supervising Ritual Erudite, and directors of the five bureaus and other officiating officials to enter first and take their places.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day at dawn, all officiants from the three offering officers downward don sacrificial robes. The ritual attendants escort the Minister of Imperial Rites, the Supervising Sacrifice Censor, the Supervising Ritual Erudite, and the directors of the five bureaus and other officiating officials to enter first and take their stations.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引監祭、監禮點視陳設畢，復位。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the Supervising Sacrifice Censor and Supervising Ritual Erudite to inspect the arrangement of offerings; when this is complete they return to their places.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the Supervising Sacrifice Censor and Supervising Ritual Erudite to inspect the ritual furnishings. When this is done, they return to their stations.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引太常卿、監祭、監禮、太廟令、太祝、宮闈令奉遷各室神主訖，降自橫街，北向立定。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the Minister of Imperial Rites, Supervising Sacrifice Censor, Supervising Ritual Erudite, Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, Chief Sacrificer, and Director of Palace Inner Quarters to convey and transfer the spirit tablets of each chamber; when this is complete they descend from the cross street and stand facing north in position.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the Minister of Imperial Rites, the Supervising Sacrifice Censor, the Supervising Ritual Erudite, the Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the Chief Sacrificer, and the Director of Palace Inner Quarters to bring out the spirit tablets of each chamber. When this is done, they descend from the cross street and stand facing north at attention.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎贊再拜，在位官皆再拜訖，奉禮郎贊各就位訖，太官令、齋郎出。

translations.literal: The Ritual Gentleman announces the double bow; all officials in position bow twice; when this is complete the Ritual Gentleman announces that each has taken his place; the Director of Imperial Kitchens and purification attendants go out.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Gentleman calls for the double bow, and all officials in attendance bow twice. The Ritual Gentleman then announces that each has taken his station, and the Director of the Imperial Kitchens and purification attendants go out.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引三獻、司徒、光祿卿、捧瓚、爵盥、爵洗官入就位，立定。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the three offering officers, Minister of Education, Minister of Imperial Household Supplies, libation-cup bearers, and cup-washing officers to enter and take their places, standing in position.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the three offering officers, the Minister of Education, the Minister of Imperial Household Supplies, libation-cup bearers, and cup-washing officers to enter, take their stations, and stand at attention.

sentences.zh: 禮直官贊「有司謹具，請行事」，降神樂作，九成止。

translations.literal: The ritual attendant announces, "The offices have reverently prepared; please proceed with the ceremony"; the spirit-descent music plays, stopping at nine sections.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendant announces, "The offices have reverently prepared everything. Please proceed with the ceremony." The spirit-descent music plays through nine sections and stops.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎贊再拜，三獻以下再拜訖，奉禮郎贊諸執事者各就位，立定。

translations.literal: The Ritual Gentleman announces the double bow; from the three offering officers downward all bow twice; when this is complete the Ritual Gentleman announces that all officiants have taken their places, standing in position.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Gentleman calls for the double bow, and from the three offering officers downward all perform it. The Ritual Gentleman then announces that all officiants have taken their stations and stand at attention.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引初獻詣盥洗位，盥手，詣爵洗位，洗瓚。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the chief offering officer to the hand-washing place; he washes his hands, proceeds to the libation-cup washing place, and washes the libation vessel.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the chief offering officer to the hand-washing station. He washes his hands, proceeds to the libation-cup washing station, and washes the libation vessel.

sentences.zh: 詣第一室酒尊所，酌郁鬯。

translations.literal: He proceeds to the wine vessel place of the first chamber and pours aromatic ceremonial wine.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeds to the wine vessel station of the first chamber and pours aromatic ceremonial wine.

sentences.zh: 詣神座前北向跪，搢笏三上香，奠幣執瓚，以鬯灌於沙池，執笏俯伏興。

translations.literal: Before the spirit seat he kneels facing north, inserts his tablet and offers incense three times, sets out the silk and holds the libation vessel, pours the aromatic wine into the sand basin, holding his tablet prostrates himself and rises.
translations.idiomatic: Before the spirit seat he kneels facing north, inserts his tablet, and offers incense three times. He sets out the silk, takes up the libation vessel, and pours the aromatic wine into the sand basin. Tablet in hand, he prostrates himself and rises.

sentences.zh: 出室戶外，再拜訖，次詣各室，並如上儀。

translations.literal: He withdraws outside the chamber door, bows twice; when this is complete he next proceeds to each chamber, all according to the ritual above.
translations.idiomatic: He withdraws outside the chamber door and performs the double bow, then proceeds to each chamber in turn according to the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，降復位。

translations.literal: When all is complete, he descends and returns to his place.
translations.idiomatic: When all is complete, he descends and returns to his station.

sentences.zh: 司徒率齋郎進饌，如常儀。

translations.literal: The Minister of Education leads the purification attendants in advancing the food offerings, according to the usual ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Education leads the purification attendants in presenting the food offerings according to the usual procedure.

sentences.zh: 奠畢，降復位。

translations.literal: When the presentation is complete, he descends and returns to his place.
translations.idiomatic: When the presentation is complete, he descends and returns to his station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引初獻詣盥洗位，盥手，詣爵洗位，洗爵。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the chief offering officer to the hand-washing place; he washes his hands, proceeds to the cup-washing place, and washes the cup.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the chief offering officer to the hand-washing station. He washes his hands, proceeds to the cup-washing station, and washes the cup.

sentences.zh: 詣第一室酒尊所，酌酒。

translations.literal: He proceeds to the wine vessel place of the first chamber and pours wine.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeds to the wine vessel station of the first chamber and pours wine.

sentences.zh: 詣神座前，北向搢笏跪，三上香，執爵三祭酒於茅苴，以爵授執事者，執笏俯伏興，出室戶外，北向立。

translations.literal: Before the spirit seat, facing north he inserts his tablet and kneels, offers incense three times, holds the cup and offers libation wine three times on the thatch bundle, hands the cup to an officiant, holding his tablet prostrates himself and rises, withdraws outside the chamber door, and stands facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Before the spirit seat he kneels facing north, inserts his tablet, and offers incense three times. He takes the cup and pours libation wine three times on the thatch bundle, then hands the cup to an officiant. Tablet in hand, he prostrates himself and rises, withdraws outside the chamber door, and stands facing north.

sentences.zh: 俟讀祝官讀祝文訖，再拜。

translations.literal: He waits until the prayer-reading officer has finished reading the prayer text, then bows twice.
translations.idiomatic: He waits for the prayer-reading officer to finish reading the prayer text, then performs the double bow.

sentences.zh: 詣每室，並如上儀。

translations.literal: He proceeds to each chamber, all according to the ritual above.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeds to each chamber according to the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，降復位。

translations.literal: When all is complete, he descends and returns to his place.
translations.idiomatic: When all is complete, he descends and returns to his station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引亞獻官盥手、洗爵、酌獻，並如初獻儀，惟不讀祝。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the secondary offering officer to wash his hands, wash the cup, and pour and offer wine, all according to the ritual of the chief offering officer, only without reading the prayer.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the secondary offering officer through hand-washing, cup-washing, and wine pouring and offering according to the chief offering officer's procedure, except that the prayer is not read.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，降復位。

translations.literal: When all is complete, he descends and returns to his place.
translations.idiomatic: When all is complete, he descends and returns to his station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引終獻，並如亞獻儀。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the final offering officer, all according to the ritual of the secondary offering officer.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the final offering officer through the same procedure as the secondary offering officer.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，復位。

translations.literal: When all is complete, he returns to his place.
translations.idiomatic: When all is complete, he returns to his station.

sentences.zh: 太祝徹籩豆，奉禮郎贊賜胙，眾官再拜。

translations.literal: The Chief Sacrificer removes the baskets and trays; the Ritual Gentleman announces that the sacrificial portion is bestowed; all officials bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Sacrificer removes the baskets and trays. The Ritual Gentleman announces that the sacrificial portion is bestowed, and all officials perform the double bow.

sentences.zh: 在位官皆再拜訖，禮直官引三獻官、司徒、太常卿、監祭、監禮視焚祝版幣帛，禮直官贊可瘞。

translations.literal: When all officials in position have bowed twice, the ritual attendants lead the three offering officers, Minister of Education, Minister of Imperial Rites, Supervising Sacrifice Censor, and Supervising Ritual Erudite to witness the burning of the prayer boards and silk offerings; the ritual attendant announces that burial may proceed.
translations.idiomatic: When all officials in attendance have completed the double bow, the ritual attendants escort the three offering officers, the Minister of Education, the Minister of Imperial Rites, the Supervising Sacrifice Censor, and the Supervising Ritual Erudite to witness the burning of the prayer boards and silk offerings. The ritual attendant then announces that burial may proceed.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，太常卿、監祭、監禮升納神主訖，降自橫階。

translations.literal: When the ritual is complete, the Minister of Imperial Rites, Supervising Sacrifice Censor, and Supervising Ritual Erudite ascend and return the spirit tablets; when this is complete they descend the cross steps.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite is complete, the Minister of Imperial Rites, the Supervising Sacrifice Censor, and the Supervising Ritual Erudite ascend to return the spirit tablets, then descend the cross steps.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎贊再拜，在位官皆再拜訖，退。

translations.literal: The Ritual Gentleman announces the double bow; all officials in position bow twice; when this is complete they withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Gentleman calls for the double bow. All officials in attendance perform it, then withdraw.

sentences.zh: 薦新儀：至日質明，太常禮儀院官屬赴廟所，皆公服俟於次。

translations.literal: Procedure for seasonal fresh offerings: on the day of the solstice at dawn, officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual go to the temple, all in official dress waiting in the side hall.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for seasonal fresh offerings: on the solstice day at dawn, officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual go to the temple and wait in the side hall, all in official dress.

sentences.zh: 太廟令率其屬升殿，開室戶，不出神主，設籩豆俎、酒醴、馬湩及室戶內外褥位。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple leads his subordinates up the hall, opens the chamber doors without bringing out the spirit tablets, and sets out baskets, trays, stands, wine and sweet wine, kumiss, and mat places inside and outside the chamber doors.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple leads his subordinates up the hall, opens the chamber doors without bringing out the spirit tablets, and arranges baskets, trays, stands, wine, sweet wine, kumiss, and mat stations inside and outside the chamber doors.

sentences.zh: 又設盥洗位於階下，少東，西向。

translations.literal: Hand-washing places are also set below the steps, slightly east, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: Hand-washing stations are also placed below the steps, slightly to the east, facing west.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎率儀鸞局設席褥版位於橫街南，又設盥盆巾帨二所於齊班幕前。

translations.literal: The Ritual Gentleman leads the Ceremonial Escort Bureau in setting mat and tablet places south of the cross street; hand-washing basins, towels, and cloths are also set in two places before the ranked-tent front.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Gentleman leads the Ceremonial Escort Bureau in arranging mat and tablet stations south of the cross street. Two sets of hand-washing basins, towels, and drying cloths are also placed before the ranked assembly tent.

sentences.zh: 凡與祭執事官皆盥手訖，太常官詣神廚點視神饌。

translations.literal: All officiating officials taking part in the sacrifice wash their hands; officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual proceed to the spirit kitchen to inspect the spirit offerings.
translations.idiomatic: All officiating officials participating in the sacrifice wash their hands. Officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual proceed to the spirit kitchen to inspect the spirit offerings.

sentences.zh: 執事者奉所薦饌物，各陳饌幕內。

translations.literal: Officiants carry the seasonal fresh offerings and set each out within the offering tents.
translations.idiomatic: Officiants carry the seasonal fresh offerings and arrange each within the offering tents.

sentences.zh: 太常官以下入就位，東西重行，北向立定。

translations.literal: From the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual officials downward all enter and take their places, in double ranks east and west, facing north and standing in position.
translations.idiomatic: From the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual officials downward, all enter and take their stations in double ranks east and west, facing north and standing at attention.

sentences.zh: 禮直官贊「皆再拜」，「鞠躬」，「拜」，「興」，「拜」，「興」，「平立」，「各就位」。

translations.literal: The ritual attendant announces in succession, "All bow twice," "Bow the body," "Bow," "Rise," "Bow," "Rise," "Stand level," "Each take his place."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendant calls in succession, "All bow twice," "Bow low," "Bow," "Rise," "Bow," "Rise," "Stand upright," and "Each take your station."

sentences.zh: 禮直官引太常次官一員，率執事者出詣饌所，奉饌入自正門，升自太階，奠各室神位前。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead one vice official of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, who leads the officiants out to the offering place, carries the offerings in through the main gate, ascends the great steps, and sets them before the spirit seat of each chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort one vice official of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual, who leads the officiants to the offering station. They carry the offerings in through the main gate, ascend the great steps, and present them before the spirit seat of each chamber.

sentences.zh: 執事者進時食，院官搢笏受而奠之。

translations.literal: Officiants advance the seasonal foods; court officials insert their tablets, receive them, and set them out.
translations.idiomatic: Officiants present the seasonal foods. Court officials insert their tablets, receive them, and set them in place.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引太常禮儀使詣盥洗位，盥手帨手。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead the Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual to the hand-washing place; he washes his hands and dries them.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort the Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual to the hand-washing station, where he washes and dries his hands.

sentences.zh: 升殿詣第一室神位前，搢笏，執事者註酒於杯，三祭酒，又註馬湩於杯，亦三祭之，奠杯於案。

translations.literal: He ascends the hall and proceeds before the spirit seat of the first chamber, inserts his tablet; an officiant pours wine into the cup; he offers libation wine three times; kumiss is again poured into the cup; he likewise offers libation three times, and sets the cup on the table.
translations.idiomatic: He ascends the hall and proceeds before the spirit seat of the first chamber and inserts his tablet. An officiant pours wine into the cup, and he pours libation wine three times. Kumiss is then poured into the cup, and he again pours libation three times, then sets the cup on the table.

sentences.zh: 出笏，就拜興，出室戶外，北向立，再拜。

translations.literal: He withdraws his tablet, rises from the bow, withdraws outside the chamber door, stands facing north, and bows twice.
translations.idiomatic: He withdraws his tablet, rises from his bow, withdraws outside the chamber door, stands facing north, and performs the double bow.

sentences.zh: 每室俱畢，降復位，執事者皆降。

translations.literal: When all chambers are complete, he descends and returns to his place; all officiants descend.
translations.idiomatic: When all chambers are complete, he descends and returns to his station, and all officiants descend.

sentences.zh: 禮直官贊「再拜」，「鞠躬」，「拜」，「興」，「拜」，「興」，「平立」，余官率執事者升徹饌，出殿闔戶。

translations.literal: The ritual attendant announces in succession, "Bow twice," "Bow the body," "Bow," "Rise," "Bow," "Rise," "Stand level"; the remaining officials lead the officiants up to remove the offerings, exit the hall, and close the doors.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendant calls in succession, "Bow twice," "Bow low," "Bow," "Rise," "Bow," "Rise," "Stand upright." The remaining officials lead the officiants up to remove the offerings, then exit the hall and close the doors.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引太常官以下俱出東神門外，圓揖。

translations.literal: The ritual attendants lead all from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual officials downward out through the eastern spirit gate and perform the circular bow.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendants escort all Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual officials out through the eastern spirit gate, where they perform the circular bow.

sentences.zh: 神御殿

translations.literal: Spirit Image Hall
translations.idiomatic: The Spirit Image Hall

sentences.zh: 神御殿，舊稱影堂。

translations.literal: The Spirit Image Hall was formerly called the Portrait Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Spirit Image Hall was formerly known as the Portrait Hall.

sentences.zh: 所奉祖宗御容，皆紋綺局織錦為之。

translations.literal: The imperial portraits of the ancestors that it enshrines are all made of patterned silk woven in the brocade bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial portraits of the ancestors enshrined there are all woven brocade produced by the pattern-silk bureau.

sentences.zh: 影堂所在：世祖帝後大聖壽萬安寺，裕宗帝後亦在焉；

translations.literal: Locations of the Portrait Halls: for Emperor Shizu and his empress, the Temple of Great Sagely Longevity and Universal Peace; for Emperor Yuzong and his empress, there as well;
translations.idiomatic: The Portrait Halls are located as follows: for Emperor Shizu and his empress, at the Temple of Great Sagely Longevity and Universal Peace; for Emperor Yuzong and his empress, there as well;

sentences.zh: 順宗帝後大普慶寺，仁宗帝後亦在焉；

translations.literal: for Emperor Shunzong and his empress, the Temple of Great Universal Celebration; for Emperor Renzong and his empress, there as well;
translations.idiomatic: for Emperor Shunzong and his empress, at the Temple of Great Universal Celebration; for Emperor Renzong and his empress, there as well;

sentences.zh: 成宗帝後大天壽萬寧寺；

translations.literal: for Emperor Chengzong and his empress, the Temple of Great Heavenly Longevity and Universal Tranquility;
