translations.idiomatic: for Emperor Chengzong and his empress, at the Temple of Great Heavenly Longevity and Universal Tranquility;

sentences.zh: 武宗及二後大崇恩福元寺，為東西二殿；

translations.literal: for Emperor Wuzong and his two empresses, the Temple of Great Glorious Grace and Primordial Blessing, comprising eastern and western halls;
translations.idiomatic: for Emperor Wuzong and his two empresses, at the Temple of Great Glorious Grace and Primordial Blessing, which has eastern and western halls;

sentences.zh: 明宗帝後大天源延聖寺；

translations.literal: for Emperor Mingzong and his empress, the Temple of Great Heavenly Source and Extended Sagehood;
translations.idiomatic: for Emperor Mingzong and his empress, at the Temple of Great Heavenly Source and Extended Sagehood;

sentences.zh: 英宗帝後大永福寺；

translations.literal: for Emperor Yingzong and his empress, the Temple of Great Eternal Blessing;
translations.idiomatic: for Emperor Yingzong and his empress, at the Temple of Great Eternal Blessing;

sentences.zh: 也可皇后大護國仁王寺。

translations.literal: for Empress Yekuo, the Temple of Great Nation-Protecting Humane Kings.
translations.idiomatic: for Empress Yekuo, at the Temple of Great Nation-Protecting Humane Kings.

sentences.zh: 世祖、武宗影堂，皆藏玉冊十有二牒，玉寶一鈕。

translations.literal: The Portrait Halls of Shizu and Wuzong both store twelve fascicles of jade registers and one jade seal with one knob.
translations.idiomatic: The Portrait Halls of Shizu and Wuzong each house twelve fascicles of jade registers and one jade seal with a single knob.

sentences.zh: 仁守影堂，藏皇太子玉冊十有二牒，皇后玉冊十有二牒，玉寶一鈕。

translations.literal: The Renzong Portrait Hall stores twelve fascicles of the crown prince's jade register, twelve fascicles of the empress's jade register, and one jade seal with one knob.
translations.idiomatic: The Renzong Portrait Hall houses twelve fascicles of the crown prince's jade register, twelve fascicles of the empress's jade register, and one jade seal with a single knob.

sentences.zh: 英宗影堂，藏皇帝玉冊十有二牒，玉寶一鈕，皇太子玉冊十有二牒。

translations.literal: The Yingzong Portrait Hall stores twelve fascicles of the emperor's jade register, one jade seal with one knob, and twelve fascicles of the crown prince's jade register.
translations.idiomatic: The Yingzong Portrait Hall houses twelve fascicles of the emperor's jade register, one jade seal with a single knob, and twelve fascicles of the crown prince's jade register.

sentences.zh: 凡帝後冊寶，以匣匱金鎖鑰藏於太廟，此其分置者。

translations.literal: In general the registers and seals of emperors and empresses are stored in the Imperial Ancestral Temple in cases and caskets with gold locks and keys; these are the ones separately placed.
translations.idiomatic: Ordinarily the registers and seals of emperors and empresses are kept in the Imperial Ancestral Temple in cases and caskets secured with gold locks and keys; these are the copies separately placed elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 其祭器，則黃金瓶斝盤盂之屬以十數，黃金塗銀香合碗楪之屬以百數，銀壺釜杯匜之屬稱是。

translations.literal: As for the ritual vessels, golden bottles, jia vessels, dishes, and the like number in the tens; gold-plated silver incense boxes, bowls, and plates number in the hundreds; silver ewers, cauldrons, cups, and pitchers are commensurate.
translations.idiomatic: Its ritual vessels include several dozen gold bottles, jia vessels, dishes, and the like; several hundred gold-plated silver incense boxes, bowls, and plates; and a corresponding quantity of silver ewers, cauldrons, cups, and pitchers.

sentences.zh: 玉器、水晶、瑪瑙之器為數不同，有玻璃瓶、琥珀勺。

translations.literal: Vessels of jade, crystal, and agate vary in number; there are glass bottles and amber ladles.
translations.idiomatic: Vessels of jade, crystal, and agate are present in varying numbers, along with glass bottles and amber ladles.

sentences.zh: 世祖影堂有真珠簾，又皆有珊瑚樹、碧甸子山之屬。

translations.literal: The Shizu Portrait Hall has a pearl curtain; all also have coral trees, lapis-lazuli mountains, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizu Portrait Hall has a pearl curtain, and all the halls have coral trees, lapis-lazuli mountain ornaments, and the like.

sentences.zh: 其祭之日，常祭每月初一日、初八日、十五日、二十三日，節祭元日、清明、蕤賓、重陽、冬至、忌辰。

translations.literal: As for the days of sacrifice: regular sacrifices on the first, eighth, fifteenth, and twenty-third days of each month; festival sacrifices on New Year's Day, Pure Brightness, fourth-month solstice, Double Ninth, winter solstice, and death anniversaries.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices are performed as follows: regular offerings on the first, eighth, fifteenth, and twenty-third days of each month; festival offerings on New Year's Day, Pure Brightness, the fourth-month solstice, Double Ninth, the winter solstice, and death anniversaries.

sentences.zh: 其祭物，常祭以蔬果，節祭忌辰用牲。

translations.literal: As for the sacrificial offerings: regular sacrifices use vegetables and fruits; festival sacrifices and death anniversaries use sacrificial victims.
translations.idiomatic: The offerings are as follows: regular sacrifices use vegetables and fruits; festival sacrifices and death anniversaries use sacrificial victims.

sentences.zh: 祭官便服，行三獻禮。

translations.literal: The offering officials wear informal dress and perform the threefold offering ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The offering officials wear informal dress and perform the threefold offering ritual.

sentences.zh: 加薦用羊羔、炙魚、饅頭、錤子、西域湯餅、圜米粥、砂糖飯羹。

translations.literal: For additional offerings they use lamb, roasted fish, steamed buns, qianzi pastries, Western Regions soup noodles, round-grain rice porridge, and sugar-sweetened rice broth.
translations.idiomatic: Additional offerings include lamb, roasted fish, steamed buns, qianzi pastries, Western Regions soup noodles, round-grain rice porridge, and sugar-sweetened rice broth.

sentences.zh: 泰定二年，亦作顯宗影堂於大天源延聖寺，天歷元年廢。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taiding, a portrait hall for Emperor Xianzong was also built at the Dayuan Yansheng Temple; it was abolished in the first year of Tianli.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Taiding, a portrait hall for Emperor Xianzong was also established at the Dayuan Yansheng Temple; it was abolished in the first year of Tianli.

sentences.zh: 舊有崇福、殊祥二院，奉影堂祀事，乃改為泰禧院。

translations.literal: Formerly there were the Chongfu and Zhuxiang courtyards, which maintained portrait-hall sacrifices; they were then changed to the Taixi Court.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Chongfu and Zhuxiang courtyards maintained portrait-hall sacrifices; they were then reorganized as the Taixi Court.

sentences.zh: 二年，又改為太禧宗禋院，秩二品。

translations.literal: In the second year it was again changed to the Taixi Ancestral Sacrifice Court, of the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year it was again renamed the Taixi Ancestral Sacrifice Court, of the second rank.

sentences.zh: 既而復以祖宗所御殿尚稱影堂，更號神御殿。

translations.literal: Thereafter, because the halls used by the ancestors were still called portrait halls, they were given the new designation Spirit Imperial Halls.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, because the halls used by the ancestors were still called portrait halls, they were given the new designation Spirit Imperial Halls.

sentences.zh: 殿皆制名以冠之：世祖曰元壽，昭睿順聖皇后曰睿壽，南必皇后曰懿壽，裕宗曰明壽，成宗曰廣壽，順宗曰衍壽，武宗曰仁壽，文獻昭聖皇后曰昭壽，仁宗曰文壽，英宗曰宣壽，明宗曰景壽。

translations.literal: Each hall was given a formal name as its title: Shizu was called Yuanshou; Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng was called Ruishou; Empress Nanbi was called Yishou; Yuzong was called Mingshou; Chengzong was called Guangshou; Shunzong was called Yanshou; Wuzong was called Renshou; Empress Wenxian Zhaosheng was called Zhaoshou; Renzong was called Wenshou; Yingzong was called Xuanshou; Mingzong was called Jingshou.
translations.idiomatic: Each hall received a formal title: Shizu was named Yuanshou; Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng, Ruishou; Empress Nanbi, Yishou; Yuzong, Mingshou; Chengzong, Guangshou; Shunzong, Yanshou; Wuzong, Renshou; Empress Wenxian Zhaosheng, Zhaoshou; Renzong, Wenshou; Yingzong, Xuanshou; and Mingzong, Jingshou.

sentences.zh: 且命學士擬其祭祀儀註，今闕。

translations.literal: The emperor also ordered academicians to draft ritual regulations for their sacrifice; these are now missing.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also ordered academicians to draft ritual regulations for these sacrifices; the text is now lost.

sentences.zh: 又有玉華宮孝思殿在真定，世祖所立。

translations.literal: There was also the Hall of Filial Remembrance in the Yuhua Palace at Zhending, established by Shizu.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Hall of Filial Remembrance in the Yuhua Palace at Zhending, established by Shizu.

sentences.zh: 以忌日享祀太上皇、皇太后御容。

translations.literal: On the anniversary of death they offered sacrifice to the imperial portraits of the Grand Supreme Emperor and the Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On the death anniversary they offered sacrifice to the imperial portraits of the Grand Supreme Emperor and the Grand Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 本路官吏祭奠，太常博士按《宋會要》定其儀。

translations.literal: Local officials of that circuit performed the offering; an Erudite of the Imperial Rites fixed the ritual according to the Song Huiyao.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of that circuit performed the offering, and an Erudite of the Imperial Rites fixed the ritual according to the Song Huiyao.

sentences.zh: 所司前期置辦茶飯、香果。

translations.literal: The responsible offices prepared tea, food, incense, and fruit in advance.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices prepared tea, food, incense, and fruit in advance.

sentences.zh: 質明，禮直官、引獻官與陪位官以下，並公服入廟庭，西向立。

translations.literal: At dawn, the ritual attendant, the leading offering official, and accompanying officials downward, all in official dress, entered the temple courtyard and stood facing west.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn, the ritual attendant, the leading offering official, and all accompanying officials, in official dress, entered the temple courtyard and stood facing west.

sentences.zh: 俱再拜訖，引獻官詣殿正階下再拜，升階至案前褥位，三上香，三奠酒訖，就拜興。

translations.literal: When all had bowed twice, the leading offering official proceeded to below the main steps of the hall and bowed twice, ascended the steps to the mat place before the table, offered incense three times and poured wine three times; when this was complete he rose from his bow.
translations.idiomatic: When all had performed the double bow, the leading offering official proceeded to the foot of the main hall steps and bowed twice, ascended to the mat before the table, offered incense three times and poured wine three times, then rose from his bow.

sentences.zh: 又再拜訖，引獻官復位，與陪位官以下俱再拜，退。

translations.literal: When he had bowed twice again, the leading offering official returned to his place; he and the accompanying officials downward all bowed twice and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He performed the double bow again, returned to his place, and he and all accompanying officials performed the double bow once more before withdrawing.

sentences.zh: 仁宗皇慶二年秋八月庚辰，命大司徒田忠良詣真定致祭，依歲例給禦香酒並犧牲祭物錢中統鈔一百錠。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year of Huangqing of Renzong, on the day gengchen of the eighth month, he ordered Grand Minister of Education Tian Zhongliang to proceed to Zhending to perform the offering; according to the annual precedent imperial incense, wine, sacrificial victims, and offering funds of one hundred ding of zhongtong notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the second year of Huangqing of Renzong, on gengchen day of the eighth month, the emperor ordered Grand Minister of Education Tian Zhongliang to proceed to Zhending to perform the offering. According to annual precedent, imperial incense, wine, sacrificial victims, and offering funds of one hundred ding of zhongtong notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 延祐四年，始用登歌樂，行三獻禮。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yanyou, ascent music was first used and the threefold offering ritual was performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yanyou, ascent music was first used and the threefold offering ritual was performed.

sentences.zh: 七年，太常博士言影堂用太常禮樂非是，制罷之，歲時本處依舊禮致祭。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, an Erudite of the Imperial Rites said that using Imperial Rites music for the portrait hall was improper; an order abolished it, and each year the local place continued to offer sacrifice according to the old ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, an Erudite of the Imperial Rites argued that using Imperial Rites music at the portrait hall was improper. An order abolished it, and thereafter the local authorities continued to offer sacrifice each year according to the old ritual.

sentences.zh: 其太祖、太宗、睿宗御容在翰林者，至元十五年十一月，命承旨和禮霍孫寫太祖御容。

translations.literal: As for the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong kept at the Hanlin Academy: in the eleventh month of the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan, the emperor ordered Academician-in-Attendance Heli Huosun to paint the portrait of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: Regarding the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong kept at the Hanlin Academy: in the eleventh month of the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan, the emperor ordered Academician-in-Attendance Heli Huosun to paint the portrait of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 十六年二月，復命寫太上皇御容，與太宗舊御容，俱置翰林院，院官春秋致祭。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixteenth year he again ordered the painting of the Grand Supreme Emperor's portrait, together with the old portrait of Taizong; all were placed in the Hanlin Academy, and the academy officials offered sacrifice in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixteenth year he again ordered the painting of the Grand Supreme Emperor's portrait, together with the old portrait of Taizong. All were placed in the Hanlin Academy, whose officials offered sacrifice in spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 二十四年二月，翰林院言舊院屋敝，新院屋才六間，三朝御容宜於太常寺安奉，後仍遷新院。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-fourth year the Hanlin Academy reported that the old academy buildings were dilapidated and the new academy had only six rooms; the portraits of the three reigns should be installed for veneration at the Ministry of Imperial Rites, and were later moved back to the new academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-fourth year the Hanlin Academy reported that the old academy buildings were dilapidated and the new academy had only six rooms. The portraits of the three reigns should be installed for veneration at the Ministry of Imperial Rites; they were later moved back to the new academy.

sentences.zh: 至大四年，翰林院移署舊尚書省，有旨月祭。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida, the Hanlin Academy moved its offices to the old Secretariat compound; an imperial order mandated monthly sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhida, the Hanlin Academy moved its offices to the old Secretariat compound, and an imperial order mandated monthly sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 中書平章完澤等言：「祭祀非小事，太廟歲一祭，執事諸臣受戒誓三日乃行事，今此輕易非宜。

translations.literal: The Associate Director of the Secretariat Wanze and others said: "Sacrifice is no small matter. The Imperial Ancestral Temple is offered to once a year, and the officiating ministers observe the abstention oath for three days before performing the rite. To treat this so lightly is not fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Director of the Secretariat Wanze and others said: "Sacrifice is no small matter. The Imperial Ancestral Temple receives sacrifice once a year, and the officiating ministers observe the purification oath for three days before performing the rite. To treat this so lightly is not fitting.

sentences.zh: 舊置翰林院御容，春秋二祭，不必增益。」

translations.literal: The imperial portraits formerly placed in the Hanlin Academy received sacrifice in spring and autumn; there was no need to add further offerings."
translations.idiomatic: The imperial portraits formerly placed in the Hanlin Academy received sacrifice in spring and autumn; there was no need to add further offerings."

sentences.zh: 制若曰「可」。

translations.literal: The decree read, "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: The decree read, "Approved."

sentences.zh: 至治三年遷置普慶寺，祀禮廢。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhizhi they were moved to the Puqing Temple, and the sacrificial rites were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhizhi they were moved to the Puqing Temple, and the sacrificial rites were abolished.

sentences.zh: 泰定二年八月，中書省臣言當祭如故，乃命承旨斡赤賫香酒至大都，同省臣祭於寺。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Taiding, Secretariat officials said sacrifice should be performed as before; the emperor then ordered Academician-in-Attendance Wanchi to bring incense and wine to Dadu, and together with Secretariat officials to offer sacrifice at the temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of Taiding, Secretariat officials said sacrifice should be performed as before. The emperor then ordered Academician-in-Attendance Wanchi to bring incense and wine to Dadu and, together with Secretariat officials, to offer sacrifice at the temple.

sentences.zh: 四年，造影堂於石佛寺，未及遷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year a portrait hall was built at the Shifo Temple, but the move had not yet been completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year a portrait hall was built at the Shifo Temple, but the relocation had not yet been completed.

sentences.zh: 至順元年七月，即普慶寺祭如故事。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Zhishun, sacrifice was performed at the Puqing Temple according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Zhishun, sacrifice was performed at the Puqing Temple according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 二年，復祀於翰林國史院。

translations.literal: In the second year sacrifice was again performed at the Hanlin Academy and National History Institute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year sacrifice was again performed at the Hanlin Academy and National History Institute.

sentences.zh: 重改至元之六年，翰林院言三朝御容祭所甚隘，兼歲久屋漏，於石佛寺新影堂奉安為宜。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of the renewed Zhiyuan era, the Hanlin Academy reported that the sacrifice place for the three reigns' portraits was very cramped and that, after many years, the roof leaked; it would be fitting to install them for veneration in the new portrait hall at the Shifo Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the renewed Zhiyuan era, the Hanlin Academy reported that the sacrifice place for the three reigns' portraits was very cramped and that, after many years, the roof leaked. It would be fitting to install them for veneration in the new portrait hall at the Shifo Temple.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣奏，此世祖定制，當仍其舊，制可。

translations.literal: Secretariat officials memorialized that this had been fixed by Shizu and should remain as before; the decree approved.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat officials memorialized that this had been established by Shizu and should remain as before; the decree approved.
